Incident remains open (SEV-2), concentrated in checkout.

Actions taken:
- Acknowledged the incident and published customer-facing updates.
- Rolled back API deploy `d-511` (v2.4.0), which had increased checkout retry attempts and removed retry jitter/budget.
- Scaled the API target and initiated the staged v2.4.2 roll-forward request; it has not yet become live.
- Capped `/checkout` at 100 req/s to drain the API connection-pool backlog and protect browsing traffic.
- Escalated to the API on-call team.

Current state: browsing is healthy (~2.9% errors), but checkout is still heavily impacted (~76% errors), largely from the intentional admission cap and residual capacity instability. API is on v2.3.9 and remains degraded.
